title: Key-only folder registry searches should request FIELD_VALUES with only SEARCH_FIELD_NAME
answers: How should cascade deletion / child-folder searches be scoped for performance?
What fields/result format to request for identity-only folder searches
Pattern for lightweight registry search requests
body: Convention: when a folder/dashboard/variable search only needs resource identity (names for cascade deletion, child-UID lists for depth validation), set Fields: []string{resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME} and ResultFormat: resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES instead of defaulting to RESOURCE_TABLE, which avoids fetching/transferring unneeded columns. Pagination must still be driven by TotalHits + offset (bleve Search doesn't populate NextPageToken reliably), not by a page token.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/folders code issuing ResourceSearchRequest for identity-only lookups (cascade delete, subtree depth validation).
says: Folder searches slower when checking for child resources
Cascade deletion fetches unnecessary folder metadata during lookups
Finding child folders retrieves too much data
Folder identity searches minimize returned fields for performance
Why does finding folders by name fetch all metadata
search: Folder registry searches for identity-only lookups (cascade deletion, child-UID depth validation) must request ResourceSearchRequest with Fields: []string{resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME} and ResultFormat: resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES instead of RESOURCE_TABLE to avoid fetching unnecessary columns. Pagination must be driven by TotalHits + offset rather than NextPageToken, since bleve Search does not populate NextPageToken reliably. Applies to dashboardsInFolder and getChildrenBatch in pkg/registry/apis/folders/cascade_delete_storage.go and pkg/registry/apis/folders/validate.go.
